description: Capture a full-page PNG screenshot of one URL, an image rather than text content. Use when a normal fetch returns 403/429, a bot-protection challenge page, a CAPTCHA, or an empty JavaScript shell. Works on anti-bot-protected sites, rendered in a real headless browser. Use wait_for to wait for an element and wait_until to control load timing. Pass actions (for example dismiss_consent or evaluate) to prepare the page; the screenshot is captured after they run and action_results is returned.

actions.description: Browser actions run in order after the page loads, before content extraction and any screenshot or PDF capture. Requires a rendered page; render_js defaults to true when actions are given. Selectors are CSS, or XPath when prefixed with '//' or 'xpath='. Failed actions are skipped and the sequence continues. The screenshot is captured after the actions run, and action_results is returned alongside it.
